title: Girlfriend Assaults Her Boyfriend Over Airpod’s & Phone Charger At The Airport
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On February 14th, 2024. Officers were called to the airport regarding a couple who were fighting with each other in public. The lady punched her boyfriend then her boyfriend retaliated and hit her back. The argument started after she claimed that her boyfriend left her airpods back in Vegas and her boyfriend denied it and that escalated to her boyfriend saying he wouldn’t give her a ride back after the trip & the car had all her belongings inside. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
